name: Twine to Org Mode exporter and Emacs Org export backend

mentions.name: Twine to Org Mode exporter and Emacs Org export backend
mentions.description: An exporter that converts Twine stories to Org Mode, paired with an Emacs Org export backend that does the reverse conversion from Org Mode back to Twine, written as tooling for authoring the interactive book.
mentions.source_excerpt: On the latter, I wrote an exporter for Twinery to Org Mode and an Emacs Org export backend to do the reverse.
